claims.statement: The contract with the Confraternity of the Immaculate Conception is dated 25 April 1483. The painting's date within the following years is an estimate. A second version in London was completed later after a legal dispute.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Contract of 25 April 1483; stylistic dating.
